# Graph structure reference (current state)

**Purpose:** Use this document for market research and to correct cluster definitions, company assignments, and inter-cluster connections before updating the app data.

**Last aligned with:** `src/data/*.json` (generated by `scripts/generate-company-data.mjs`)

**Data revision (May 2026):** Cluster descriptions tightened; **32 canonical backbone edges** (no random edges); semi loop fixed (`semi_equipment → semi_fabrication` bottleneck + `semi_fabrication → semi_equipment` commercial); company moves (AI→enterprise, ANET→networking, ASX→packaging); `roles[]` on dual-exposure names; cluster-level score baselines (not pure RNG).

---

## 1. Mental model

The graph has two node layers:

| Layer | Count | What it represents |
|-------|------:|--------------------|
| **Industry clusters** | 17 | Segments of the AI value chain (e.g. memory, hyperscalers) |
| **Companies** | 105 | Public (or illustrative private) names assigned to exactly one cluster; dual roles in `roles[]` |

**Edges exist only between clusters**, not between individual companies. Companies are visual grouping only; dependency logic is cluster → cluster.

```
[Company nodes]  →  belong to  →  [Cluster node]
                                      ↓
                              [Cluster → Cluster edges]
```

**Scores** use cluster-level baselines with small per-company jitter. **Edges** have fixed directions, types, lags, strengths, and starter `evidence` URLs (BVP, OECD, McKinsey)—extend with your own research citations.

---

## 2. Value chain order (clusters)

Clusters are ordered `0 → 16` in `clusters.json`. The UI lays them out top-to-bottom in this sequence (serpentine left/right columns). Order is **not** enforced on edges—connections can skip steps or run “backward.”

| Order | ID | Label | Short | One-line scope |
|------:|----|-------|-------|----------------|
| 0 | `raw_materials` | Raw Materials & Mining | Raw Mat | Copper, lithium, rare earths, industrial metals |
| 1 | `utilities_power` | Utilities & Grid | Grid | Utilities, renewables, grid operators |
| 2 | `power_electrical` | Power & Electrical Equipment | Power Eq | Transformers, switchgear, UPS, campus electrical |
| 3 | `cooling_thermal` | Cooling & Thermal | Cooling | Liquid cooling, chillers, rack thermal |
| 4 | `data_center_infra` | Data Center Infrastructure | DC Infra | Colocation, DC REITs, operators |
| 5 | `semi_fabrication` | Semiconductor Fabrication | Fabs | Foundries, IDMs |
| 6 | `semi_equipment` | Semi Equipment & Lithography | Semi Eq | EUV, deposition, etch, inspection |
| 7 | `packaging_osat` | Advanced Packaging & OSAT | Packaging | CoWoS, OSAT, advanced packaging |
| 8 | `memory_storage` | Memory & Storage | Memory | HBM, DRAM, NAND, storage systems |
| 9 | `ai_accel_compute` | AI Accelerators & Compute | AI Compute | GPUs, custom ASICs, accelerator IP |
| 10 | `networking_optical` | Networking & Optical | Networking | Switches, NICs, optics, DCI |
| 11 | `contract_manufacturing` | Contract Manufacturing | EMS | Server/rack assembly, EMS |
| 12 | `hyperscaler_cloud` | Hyperscaler & Cloud Platforms | Hyperscaler | AWS, Azure, GCP-scale operators |
| 13 | `ai_model_labs` | AI Model Labs | Model Labs | Frontier model / API companies |
| 14 | `enterprise_software` | Enterprise Software & SaaS | Enterprise | SaaS embedding AI |
| 15 | `digital_advertising` | Digital Advertising & Media | Ads | Ad platforms, retail media |
| 16 | `industrial_automation` | Industrial & Automation | Industrial | Factory/building automation adjacent to capex |

**Connectivity summary (clusters only):**

- **Only source with no incoming edges:** `raw_materials`
- **All other clusters** have at least one incoming edge
- **Every cluster** has at least one outgoing edge (none are dead ends)
- **Total cluster edges:** 32 (canonical backbone only)

## 3. Edge types (ontology)

Defined in `src/types/graph.ts`. Used for filtering and styling in the app.

| Edge type | Intended meaning (for your research) |
|-----------|----------------------------------------|
| `physical_dependency` | Upstream physical input required downstream (materials, components, infrastructure) |
| `power_flow` | Electricity / grid / power delivery |
| `capacity_translation` | Upstream capacity expansion enables downstream shipments or buildout |
| `bottleneck_constraint` | Upstream segment binds or limits downstream when scarce |
| `commercial_flow` | B2B revenue / procurement relationship (not necessarily physical) |
| `data_flow` | Data, APIs, or digital dependency |
| `revenue_capture` | Downstream monetization of upstream investment (often “who gets paid”) |
| `competitive_dependency` | **Defined in types but not used in current `edges.json`** |

**Edge fields:**

| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `source`, `target` | Cluster IDs only |
| `strength` | 0–1-ish; mostly random `0.55 + random * 0.35` on template edges |
| `directionality` | Always `directed` |
| `lag` | Often `"6-36 months"` on template edges; absent on some random edges |
| `flowType` | Always `inter_cluster` |
| `evidence` | Always `[]` today—fill during research |

| Source | Target | Type | Research notes |

| data_center_infra | hyperscaler_cloud | capacity_translation | Colo/capacity → cloud buildout |
| semi_fabrication | semi_equipment | bottleneck_constraint | **Review direction:** template says fab → equipment; often equipment availability constrains fabs |

| semi_fabrication | packaging_osat | capacity_translation | Wafers → packaging |
| semi_fabrication | memory_storage | capacity_translation | Fab capacity → memory output |
| packaging_osat | memory_storage | physical_dependency | Packaging → memory products |
| packaging_osat | ai_accel_compute | physical_dependency | Advanced packaging → accelerators |
| memory_storage | ai_accel_compute | bottleneck_constraint | HBM/memory binds GPU shipments |
| ai_accel_compute | networking_optical | data_flow | Accelerators ↔ cluster networking |
| ai_accel_compute | contract_manufacturing | capacity_translation | Silicon → server assembly |
| contract_manufacturing | hyperscaler_cloud | commercial_flow | EMS → hyperscaler procurement |
| networking_optical | hyperscaler_cloud | data_flow | Fabric → cloud operations |
| hyperscaler_cloud | ai_model_labs | commercial_flow | Cloud/GPU → model training & APIs |
| hyperscaler_cloud | enterprise_software | commercial_flow | Cloud → SaaS |
| hyperscaler_cloud | digital_advertising | revenue_capture | CapEx → ads monetization |
| ai_model_labs | enterprise_software | data_flow | Models → enterprise products |
| ai_model_labs | digital_advertising | revenue_capture | Models → ads use cases |
| enterprise_software | digital_advertising | revenue_capture | SaaS → ads (weak / review) |
| networking_optical | ai_model_labs | data_flow | Networking → labs (skips hyperscaler) |
| industrial_automation | power_electrical | commercial_flow | Industrial buyers of electrical gear |

### 4b. Random / weak edges (added at generation time)

The generator also appends up to ~25 random forward hops (`order` increases, gap ≤ 4). **Current `edges.json` includes these five extras** (lower strength, generic descriptions):

| ID | Source | Target | Type | Strength |
|----|--------|--------|------|----------|
| ce_28 | ai_model_labs | enterprise_software | commercial_flow | 0.29 |
| ce_29 | digital_advertising | industrial_automation | commercial_flow | 0.32 |
| ce_30 | raw_materials | utilities_power | commercial_flow | 0.44 |
| ce_31 | memory_storage | hyperscaler_cloud | commercial_flow | 0.44 |
| ce_32 | ai_accel_compute | ai_model_labs | commercial_flow | 0.31 |

**Note:** `ai_model_labs → enterprise_software` appears **twice** with different types (`data_flow` in template, `commercial_flow` in random). Consider merging or removing duplicates when you edit data.

## 6. Tickers listed in generator but assigned elsewhere (deduped)

When expanding company lists, these appear in **multiple** clusters in `scripts/generate-company-data.mjs` but only the **first** cluster below owns them in `nodes.json`:

| Ticker | Kept in cluster | Also listed under (ignored) |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------------------|
| ASX | semi_fabrication | packaging_osat |
| INTC | semi_fabrication | ai_accel_compute |
| ANET | ai_accel_compute | networking_optical |
| AVGO | ai_accel_compute | networking_optical |
| EMR | power_electrical | industrial_automation |
| ETN | power_electrical | industrial_automation |
| AMZN | hyperscaler_cloud | digital_advertising |
| MSFT | hyperscaler_cloud | enterprise_software |
| GOOGL | hyperscaler_cloud | digital_advertising |
| META | hyperscaler_cloud | digital_advertising |
| ORCL | hyperscaler_cloud | enterprise_software |

**Research implication:** Dual-role companies (e.g. Meta as hyperscaler + ads) are **not** modeled as multi-cluster nodes today. Options: pick primary cluster, add company→company edges later, or allow multi-membership in a future schema.

Shortest-path in the app follows **cluster edges only**; if no path exists, tracing returns nothing.

## 8. Scenarios (score overrides only)

Scenarios in `src/data/scenarios.json` do **not** add/remove edges. They bump scores on selected clusters for views like bottleneck / value capture:

| ID | Theme |
|----|--------|
| base | Neutral |
| power_bottleneck | Utilities + power equipment stressed |
| gpu_abundance | Compute eases; hyperscaler value capture up |
| hbm_shortage | Memory + packaging bottlenecks |
| monetization_shortfall | Ads + enterprise value capture down |
| inference_efficiency | Model labs gain; hardware intensity fades |
| delayed_interconnect | Utilities + DC infra stressed |

## 9. Known gaps for market research (checklist)

Use this as a working list while correcting the model:

### Structure

- [ ] Confirm 17 clusters cover your investable universe; split/merge if needed (e.g. separate “grid interconnect” from utilities).
- [ ] Decide whether **company-to-company** or **company-to-cluster** edges are needed for issuer-level work.
- [ ] Remove or justify **random weak edges** (section 4b); regenerate without random loop if you want a clean DAG.
- [ ] Resolve **duplicate** `ai_model_labs → enterprise_software` (two edge types).
- [ ] Review **bidirectional semi loop** (`semi_fabrication ↔ semi_equipment`) for economic direction and type.
- [ ] Add missing physical links you care about (e.g. `utilities_power → cooling_thermal`, `networking_optical → contract_manufacturing`) if evidence supports them.
- [ ] Fill `evidence` arrays (URLs, filing refs, dates) per edge.

### Company placement

- [ ] Reassign dual-role names (section 6) or allow multi-cluster membership.
- [ ] Private labs (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, etc.) are illustrative tickers—not listed equities.
- [ ] CONE (CyrusOne) is private/post-takeover; confirm whether to keep as illustrative.
- [ ] Expand packaging_osat (only 2 names) and industrial_automation (3 names) if those segments matter for your thesis.

### Edge semantics

- [ ] Validate `bottleneck_constraint` vs `physical_dependency` direction on memory → accelerators and fab ↔ equipment.
- [ ] `cooling_thermal → ai_accel_compute` skips `data_center_infra`—intentional shortcut or add DC path?
- [ ] `revenue_capture` edges to ads—document mechanism (ROI on AI capex vs ad tech stack).

### Scores

- [ ] All node scores are **randomized** on each `node scripts/generate-company-data.mjs` run unless you pin them—replace with researched values or external data.

## 10. How to update data after research

| Goal | Where to edit |
|------|----------------|
| Cluster definitions / order | `scripts/generate-company-data.mjs` → `CLUSTERS` and `clusters.json` |
| Company membership | `COMPANIES_BY_CLUSTER` in same script |
| Backbone edges | `clusterEdgeTemplates` in same script |
| Disable random edges | Remove or comment the `for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++)` loop in the script |
| Regenerate JSON | `node scripts/generate-company-data.mjs` |
| Hand-edit without regen | `src/data/nodes.json`, `edges.json` (will be overwritten on regen) |

**App behavior (for reference):**

- Filters: cluster chips, edge-type toggles, show/hide clusters and companies.
- Graph renders cluster boxes + company dots; **only cluster IDs** appear in edge source/target.
- Files: `src/store/graphData.ts` bundles JSON at build time.
